name: Common cold and cough
eat: drink a hot lemon and honey drink to soothe a sore throat
avoid: avoid contact with other people until feeling better
rest: stay at home if not feeling well enough for normal activities

name: Allergy and hay fever
avoid: do not smoke or be around smoke
do not spend too much time outside
rest: shower and change clothes after being outside

name: Acidity and heartburn
avoid: do not have food or drink that triggers symptoms
do not drink too much alcohol
rest: try to find ways to relax

name: Urinary tract infection
avoid: avoid drinks that may irritate the bladder such as fruit juices coffee and alcohol
rest: rest and drink enough fluids so you pass pale urine regularly during the day

name: Diarrhoea
eat: eat when you feel able to
avoid foods that are fatty or spicy
avoid: do not have fruit juice or fizzy drinks
rest: stay at home and get plenty of rest

name: Nausea and vomiting
avoid: do not eat or cook strong-smelling food
do not eat hot fried or greasy food
do not lie down soon after eating
rest: take regular sips of a cold drink

name: Headache
avoid: do not strain your eyes for a long time
rest: get plenty of rest if you also have a cold or flu
